---
title: "Hello Typst!"
format:
  typst:
    toc: true
    section-numbering: 1.1.a
    columns: 2
---


```{=typst}
#set page(width: auto, height: auto, margin: 1cm)

#import "@preview/fletcher:0.5.8": diagram, node, edge

#diagram(
  node-stroke: 0.8pt,
  node-fill: rgb("f9f9f9"),
  spacing: (15mm, 10mm),

  // Inputs and weights
  node((0, 0), $x$, radius: 5mm),
  node((0, 1), $w_1$, radius: 5mm),
  node((0, 2.5), $w_2$, radius: 5mm),
  node((0, 3.5), $y$, radius: 5mm),

  // Multiplication
  node((1.5, 0.5), $times$, radius: 6mm, name: <mul1>),
  node((1.5, 3.0), $times$, radius: 6mm, name: <mul2>),

  edge((0, 0), <mul1>, "->"),
  edge((0, 1), <mul1>, "->"),
  edge((0, 2.5), <mul2>, "->"),
  edge((0, 3.5), <mul2>, "->"),

  // Addition
  node((3.0, 1.75), $+$, radius: 6mm, name: <add>),

  edge(<add>, <act>, "->", label: $z$, label-pos: 0.5, label-side: auto),
  edge(<mul2>, <add>, "->", label: $w_2 y$, label-pos: 0.4, label-side: right),

  // Activation
  node(
    (4.5, 1.75),
    $sigma$,
    radius: 6mm,
    fill: rgb("e6f2ff"),
    stroke: blue + 1pt,
    name: <act>,
  ),

  edge(<add>, <act>, "->", label: $z$, label-pos: 0.5, label-side: auto ),

  // Output
  node((6.0, 1.75), $f(x, y)$, stroke: none, fill: none, name: <out>),
  edge(<act>, <out>, "->"),
)
```
